- Data retention: Hemera to confirm retention window options (30/90/365 days) and whether they support customer-managed keys for encryption at rest

Please confirm these milestones or propose adjustments — once we align I'll upload the MAP PDF (MAP-Hemera-PhasePlan.pdf) and circulate to legal/procurement.
